rules.description: Only registered and approved source domains defined in trusted_sources.json are permitted to enter the trusted knowledge base.
Raw source documents ingested into data/raw/ must be preserved unchanged and never modified.
Every ingested document must retain its original canonical source URL.
Every ingested document must record the exact date and timestamp of retrieval.
Every ingested document must be tagged with its source_type and authority_tier.
Documents originating from unapproved or unregistered domains must not automatically enter the trusted knowledge base.
Secondary sources must never automatically override primary official legal sources.
If two sources conflict, the higher-authority source should be preferred for ranking, but the conflict must be logged for manual review.
Source authority score is a ranking and prioritization signal only; authority score alone does NOT determine whether a legal claim is true.
Claim verification must evaluate the legal claim directly against the actual extracted evidence text.
Missing, incomplete, or unverifiable source metadata must cause the document to be flagged for review.
